comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Outsources services to universities for a revenue share; it doesn't operate schools or enroll students itself.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Operates for-profit allied health and nursing colleges funded by student aid, but it is a small single-state campus operator with no online or military focus.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Operates for-profit online and campus universities for adult students, including health sciences, funded by Title IV tuition.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Operates online and campus universities for working adults with military and employer channels, funded by tuition and Title IV.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly K-12 virtual school operator paid by public school funding, a different customer and revenue base.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Campus-based vocational trades training for automotive and skilled trades, not online adult degree or nursing education.
